notes.note: Rechecked each citing page after replacing the IsolateSandboxedIframes opt-out with a host-served bootstrap document and fixing the late re-close of destroyed targets. openTarget can now load a caller's constant document from http://station-document.invalid/, answered once by CDP Fetch for that target's main frame; only HtmlReplyPreview uses it, and the Browser pane's launch arguments, URL policy, about:blank start page and untracked-target closing are unchanged except that a target already destroyed is no longer closed a second time. No citing page states the preview's parent URL, a feature list, or the re-close behaviour; the preview change is recorded in docs/decisions/html-replies.md. No prose change needed.
